info.title: Molecular Oncology Almanac API
info.description:
The Molecular Oncology Almanac (MOAlmanac) is a paired knowledgebase and clinical interpretation algorithm for precision cancer medicine. Visit [our website](https://moalmanac.org) for more information.

**Filtering**

- Different filters combine with AND: `?gene=BRAF&disease=Melanoma` returns records matching all of them.
- Repeating a filter combines its values with OR: `?gene=BRAF&gene=KRAS` returns records matching any of them.
- Exception: on `/search`, the `document`, `indication`, and `agent_id` filters narrow each proposition's statement aggregates rather than which propositions are returned. See the `/search` endpoint for details.

Allele.title: Allele
Allele.description: A VRS Allele with its SequenceLocation embedded. The referenced `hgvs.*` keys become `expressions` and the `state_*` keys become `state`.

state.description: The allele's state, one of the VRS state types defined in `$defs`, selected by `type`.

location.description: Amino acid position 600 of the Refseq protein NP_004324.2, which is the protein product of the MANE Select coding transcript for BRAF (refseq:NM_004333.6).

sequenceReference.name: NP_004324.2
sequenceReference.description: The protein product of the MANE Select coding transcript for BRAF (refseq:NM_004333.6), corresponding to the Refseq protein accession NP_004324.2.

Allele.LiteralSequenceExpression.description: A state given as a literal sequence.

Allele.ReferenceLengthExpression.description: A state given as a length relative to the reference, e.g. a repeat expansion or deletion.

BiomarkerCriterion.title: BiomarkerCriterion
BiomarkerCriterion.description: Interim link between a proposition and a biomarker (a draft Cat-VRS categorical variant criterion), with the biomarker embedded as `subject`.

location.description: Amino acid position 600 of the Refseq protein NP_004324.2, which is the protein product of the MANE Select coding transcript for BRAF (refseq:NM_004333.6).

sequenceReference.name: NP_004324.2
sequenceReference.description: The protein product of the MANE Select coding transcript for BRAF (refseq:NM_004333.6), corresponding to the Refseq protein accession NP_004324.2.

Biomarker.title: Biomarker
Biomarker.description: A Cat-VRS CategoricalVariant whose allele, location, genes, function, and copy change are shaped into `constraints`. Root type `Biomarker` with one subtype per `biomarker_type` extension value.

location.description: Amino acid position 600 of the Refseq protein NP_004324.2, which is the protein product of the MANE Select coding transcript for BRAF (refseq:NM_004333.6).

sequenceReference.name: NP_004324.2
sequenceReference.description: The protein product of the MANE Select coding transcript for BRAF (refseq:NM_004333.6), corresponding to the Refseq protein accession NP_004324.2.

Biomarker.Biomarker.description: Root type shared by every biomarker. Subtypes below are selected by the `biomarker_type` extension; the top-level schema closes the record.

orderKnown.description: True only when both partners are known.

Biomarker.CopyNumber.description: Gene-level copy number change: a gene and a copy change.

Biomarker.CopyNumberArmLevel.description: Arm-level copy number change: a location and a copy change.

Biomarker.GeneFusion.description: Gene fusion, represented by a single AdjacencyConstraint. A fusion with one known partner has an UnspecifiedElement for the other.

Biomarker.GermlineVariant.description: Germline variant: a location and a FeatureContextConstraint.

Biomarker.NonFusionRearrangement.description: Structural shape shared by `Rearrangement` and `Translocation`: a gene fusion's genes collapse into a single AdjacencyConstraint, while these use one FeatureContextConstraint per gene instead. A `Translocation` may also carry a `DefiningLocationConstraint` per chromosome when it's named by cytogenetic band rather than gene (`Rearrangement`'s `location` is always empty, so it can never actually produce one).

Biomarker.ProteinExpression.description: Protein expression, e.g. PD-L1 TPS >= 1%. No constraints.

Biomarker.Rearrangement.description: Chromosomal rearrangement that is neither a gene fusion nor a translocation (see `Gene fusion`, `Translocation`). Shares `NonFusionRearrangement`'s shape.

Biomarker.Translocation.description: Chromosomal translocation between one or two partner genes, or between one or two chromosomes. Shares `NonFusionRearrangement`'s shape, but also allows a `DefiningLocationConstraint` per chromosome when the translocation is named by cytogenetic band rather than gene.

Biomarker.SomaticVariant.description: Somatic variant: a FeatureContextConstraint, plus an allele or location and optionally a function.

Biomarker.TumorMutationalBurden.description: Tumor mutational burden classification. No constraints.

Biomarker.WildType.description: Absence of variants in a gene: a location and a gene.

Coding.title: Coding
Coding.description: A code within a coding system, e.g. `oncotree:BRCA` or `ncit:C97660`.

Contribution.title: Contribution
Contribution.description: A dated contribution by an agent, with the agent embedded as `contributor`.

contributor.name: Food and Drug Administration
contributor.description: Regulatory agency that approves drugs for use in the United States.

CopyChange.title: CopyChange
CopyChange.description: A copy change term, e.g. gain or loss.

Disease.title: Disease
Disease.description: A cancer type concept with its primary coding and mappings embedded.
